
```{r cluster kinetics}
# pick genes
goi_up = filter(tc_dea, treatment == "IL1B" & peak_sig == "up") %>% 
  pull(Gene) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  sort()

goi_dn = filter(tc_dea, treatment == "IL1B" & peak_sig == "dn") %>% 
  pull(Gene) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  sort()

# k-means function
run_kmeans <- function(
    geneList,
    dataFrame = tc_dea,
    clusterPrefix,
    nClusters,
    ttt = "IL1B",
    clusterOptimizationMode = F
){
    
    # build matrix
    mat = dataFrame %>%
      filter(treatment == ttt & Gene %in% geneList) %>%
      select(Gene, time, log2fold) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = "time", values_from = "log2fold") %>%
      column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
      t() %>% scale() %>% t()
    
    if (!clusterOptimizationMode){
      
      # run clustering
      set.seed(777)
      clust = mat %>%
        kmeans(centers = nClusters, nstart = nClusters, iter.max = 100) %>%
        .$cluster %>%
        as.data.frame(nm = "cluster") %>%
        mutate(cluster = paste0(clusterPrefix, cluster)) %>%
        rownames_to_column("Gene")
      
      return(clust)
      
    }
    
    else {
      
      # optimize #clusters
      sil = fviz_nbclust(mat, kmeans, method = "silhouette", linecolor = "black")
      wss = fviz_nbclust(mat, kmeans, method = "wss", linecolor = "black")
      
      print(sil)
      print(wss)
      
    }
    
}

# run tests
run_kmeans(geneList = goi_up, clusterOptimizationMode = T)
run_kmeans(geneList = goi_dn, clusterOptimizationMode = T)

# run clustering
clust_up = run_kmeans(geneList = goi_up, clusterPrefix = "up_", nClusters = 6)
clust_dn = run_kmeans(geneList = goi_dn, clusterPrefix = "dn_", nClusters = 4)

# name clusters
cluster_assignments = rbind(clust_up, clust_dn) %>% 
  arrange(Gene) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(
      cluster,
      levels = c(
        "up_4", "up_3", "up_5", "up_2", "up_6", "up_1",
        "dn_4", "dn_3", "dn_1", "dn_2"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shape = case_when(
      cluster == "up_4" ~ "very early",
      cluster == "up_3" ~ "early",
      cluster == "up_5" ~ "mid",
      cluster == "up_2" ~ "mid-late",
      cluster == "up_6" ~ "late",
      cluster == "up_1" ~ "sustained",
      cluster == "dn_4" ~ "early",
      cluster == "dn_3" ~ "mid",
      cluster == "dn_1" ~ "mid-late",
      cluster == "dn_2" ~ "late"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shape = factor(
      shape,
      levels = c(
        "very early", "early", "mid", "mid-late", "mid-late-2", "late", "sustained"
      )
    )
  )

# check clusters
df = tc_dea %>%
  left_join(cluster_assignments, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cluster),
    treatment == "IL1B"
    )

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = time, y = log2fold)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = cluster),
    geom = "line",
    fun = "mean"
    ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")

cleanup_objects()
```

```{r fig 2a, fig.height=6, fig.width=3}
df = tc_dea %>%
  left_join(cluster_assignments, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cluster),
    treatment == "IL1B"
    )

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = time, y = log2fold)
) +
  facet_grid(
    shape~peak_sig,
    labeller = labeller(
      peak_sig = c(
        "up" = "upreg",
        "dn" = "downreg"
      )
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = Gene),
    alpha = 0.1
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    geom = "line",
    fun = "mean",
    aes(group = cluster, color = peak_sig),
    lwd = 1
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    lwd = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(3, -3)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("firebrick2", "steelblue2")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "time (h)",
    y = "log2fold"
  )

cleanup_objects()
```
